name: Health Potion
description: Red flask with sparkle particles, restores health when collected.

name: Gold Key
description: Ornate golden key with gem inset, unlocks treasure chests.

name: Floor Spikes
description: Iron spikes embedded in stone block; extends and retracts. Deadly to step on while extended.

name: Coil Spring
description: Metal coil spring mounted to floor plate; compresses on contact then launches upward.

name: Wooden Ladder
description: Vertical wooden ladder with iron rivets, two rails and evenly spaced rungs. Static interactive prop.

name: Checkpoint Flag
description: Stone pedestal with a fabric flag on a pole; flag waves when the checkpoint activates.
